meta.name: Marbled Endpapers
meta.notes: Primary and accent (plus two derived tints, a deep primary and a cream vein) float as ink in a live canvas marbling bath; its snapshot then drives every edge band, plate corner, roundel and printer's device, while cream paper, ink text and rules stay template-owned.

issues: Hero 'endpaper' doesn't read as marbling: 5-7 small drops with 3-5 rings float in a mostly empty pale bath, so it looks like scattered heart-shaped stickers, not a full-bleed marbled sheet
Combing is too coarse (5 tines + 2 verticals), so the pre-combed pattern never feathers; no get-gel or nonpareil character
Edge bands, plate corners, roundel and CTA endpaper sample the snapshot of that sparse canvas, so most bands are flat bath colour with a stray blob
Catalog CTA endpaper is a 1:1 blow-up of the same sparse hero pattern, so it repeats like a second hero
Brand initials placeholder (data-i ::after) shows through product photos because of mix-blend-mode:multiply, giving ghost 'HN' letters on the plates
Missing or failed category images leave blank cream boxes with faint initials (Fredimare Kreeften/Oesters)
Stress brand: the long header CTA 'Bekijk het assortiment' overlaps the last nav item 'Contact'
Mobile: the bookplate fills almost the whole hero, leaving a sliver of marble and almost no endpaper feel
Typography (Italiana/Spectral SC), running heads, folios, TOC leaders and the colophon are strong; layout rhythm is good but the hero undercuts it
fixed: Rebuilt the pre-combed scene: drops are sized to the bath area (sqrt(W*H)), with 5-7 concentric rings per site, so floated ink covers the whole sheet on every viewport. It's still the exact drop transform with 120-vertex polygons

Replaced the comb with a proper get-gel pass: 9 alternating horizontal tine lines, then 4 alternating vertical sweeps that feather them. The bath is tinted toward accent/primary so gaps read as ink, not paper. Intro frames were rebalanced so the float-and-comb animation stays brisk
Bands, corners, swatches and the colophon device now sample a dense, combed sheet. The CTA endpaper uses a zoomed, offset crop so it no longer copies the hero
Initials placeholder is suppressed when a frame holds an image (:has). An empty or failed frame becomes a marbled swatch with a small cream label
Header nav is now flexible and scrolls horizontally when crowded. The CTA truncates and hides between 901-1180px, so long nav/CTA labels can't collide
Mobile hero: narrower bookplate, larger marble margins and a scaled title, so the endpaper frames the plate like a real book
All fixes applied to both template.html and catalog.html; Mustache contract untouched
